findings.title: Asynchronous persistence outcomes
findings.gap: Set returns before its background write completes; persistence failures are only logged.
findings.impact: Operators can distinguish completed and failed background persistence without treating an accepted Set as durable success.
findings.required_fix: Operators can distinguish completed and failed background persistence without treating an accepted Set as durable success.

findings.title: Search indexing pressure
findings.gap: The bounded index channel can overflow into waiting goroutines without an observable pressure signal.
findings.impact: A bounded signal exposes actual queued or active index work without claiming unmeasured index freshness.
findings.required_fix: A bounded signal exposes actual queued or active index work without claiming unmeasured index freshness.

findings.title: Capacity eviction
findings.gap: Capacity pressure silently removes the least-recently-used in-memory entry.
findings.impact: A capacity-eviction event is observable without using keys or values as metric attributes.
